notes.title: 16.12.2015 Update
notes.content:
Greetings from Switzerland!

Thanks to some of our players we could find some bugs and fixed them.
Mainly we removed William Tells Moonwalk "performance",
occuring while using gamepads.

In addition various little bugs and level design problems were fixed.

Thanks for your help!

notes.title: Greenlit and done
notes.content:
Thanks to you we got greenlit!
Thanks to you we are now releasing on Steam!

The Tale of the Crossbow Warrior will carry on, because of you guys.

Thank you, from the bottom of our hearts.
You are awesome!

Have fun with Crossbow Warrior
MobyDick Games Team
